mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_coupon ( id, user_id, coupon_template_id, status, valid_start_at, valid_end_at, received_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{couponTemplateId}, 'UNUSED', #{validStartAt}, #{validEndAt}, #{receivedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, coupon_template_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS "userId", encode(id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId" FROM user_coupon WHERE coupon_template_id = #{couponTemplateId} AND status IN ('UNUSED', 'LOCKED', 'USED')
mapper.sql: encode(uc.id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", uc.user_id AS "userId", encode(uc.coupon_template_id, 'hex') AS "couponTemplateId", uc.status AS "status", uc.valid_start_at AS "validStartAt", uc.valid_end_at AS "validEndAt", uc.received_at AS "receivedAt", uc.locked_order_no AS "lockedOrderNo", uc.locked_at AS "lockedAt", uc.used_order_no AS "usedOrderNo", uc.used_at AS "usedAt", uc.version AS "userCouponVersion", uc.created_at AS "userCouponCreatedAt", uc.updated_at AS "userCouponUpdatedAt", ct.coupon_code AS "couponCode", ct.name, ct.discount_type AS "discountType", ct.threshold_amount_yuan AS "thresholdAmountYuan", ct.discount_amount_yuan AS "discountAmountYuan", ct.discount_rate AS "discountRate", ct.max_discount_amount_yuan AS "maxDiscountAmountYuan", ct.total_quantity AS "totalQuantity", ct.remaining_quantity AS "remainingQuantity", ct.per_user_limit AS "perUserLimit", ct.scope_type AS "scopeType", ct.receive_start_at AS "receiveStartAt", ct.receive_end_at AS "receiveEndAt", ct.valid_start_at AS "templateValidStartAt", ct.valid_end_at AS "templateValidEndAt", ct.status AS "templateStatus", ct.version AS "templateVersion", ct.created_at AS "templateCreatedAt", ct.updated_at AS "templateUpdatedAt"

encode(uc.id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", encode(uc.coupon_template_id, 'hex') AS "couponTemplateId", uc.user_id AS "userId", uc.status AS "userCouponStatus", uc.valid_start_at AS "validStartAt", uc.valid_end_at AS "validEndAt", ct.name AS "name", ct.discount_type AS "discountType", ct.threshold_amount_yuan AS "thresholdAmountYuan", ct.discount_amount_yuan AS "discountAmountYuan", ct.discount_rate AS "discountRate", ct.max_discount_amount_yuan AS "maxDiscountAmountYuan", ct.scope_type AS "scopeType", ct.status AS "templateStatus", ct.valid_start_at AS "templateValidStartAt", ct.valid_end_at AS "templateValidEndAt", CASE WHEN ct.scope_type = 'ALL' THEN true ELSE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coupon_scope cs WHERE cs.coupon_template_id = ct.id AND ( (ct.scope_type = 'CATEGORY' AND cs.scope_target_type = 'CATEGORY' AND cs.category_id = #{categoryId}) OR (ct.scope_type = 'SPU' AND cs.scope_target_type = 'SPU' AND cs.spu_id = #{spuId}) OR (ct.scope_type = 'SKU' AND cs.scope_target_type = 'SKU' AND cs.sku_id = #{skuId}) ) ) END AS "scopeMatched"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_coupon uc INNER JOIN coupon_template ct ON ct.id = uc.coupon_template_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.status IN ('UNUSED', 'LOCKED') AND ct.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'DISABLED', 'EXPIRED') ORDER BY uc.received_at DESC, uc.created_at DESC

WITH target AS ( SELECT uc.id, uc.coupon_template_id, ct.discount_type, ct.threshold_amount_yuan, ct.discount_amount_yuan, ct.discount_rate, ct.max_discount_amount_yuan FROM user_coupon uc INNER JOIN coupon_template ct ON ct.id = uc.coupon_template_id WHERE uc.id = #{userCouponId} AND uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.status = 'UNUSED' AND uc.valid_start_at <= #{now} AND uc.valid_end_at > #{now} AND ct.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ct.valid_start_at <= #{now} AND ct.valid_end_at > #{now} AND #{orderAmountYuan} >= ct.threshold_amount_yuan AND ( ct.scope_type = 'ALL' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coupon_scope cs WHERE cs.coupon_template_id = ct.id AND ( (ct.scope_type = 'CATEGORY' AND cs.scope_target_type = 'CATEGORY' AND cs.category_id = #{categoryId}) OR (ct.scope_type = 'SPU' AND cs.scope_target_type = 'SPU' AND cs.spu_id = #{spuId}) OR (ct.scope_type = 'SKU' AND cs.scope_target_type = 'SKU' AND cs.sku_id = #{skuId}) ) ) ) ), updated AS ( UPDATE user_coupon uc SET status = 'LOCKED', locked_order_no = #{orderNo}, locked_at = #{now}, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 FROM target t WHERE uc.id = t.id RETURNING uc.id, t.coupon_template_id, t.discount_type, t.threshold_amount_yuan, t.discount_amount_yuan, t.discount_rate, t.max_discount_amount_yuan ) SELECT encode(id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", encode(coupon_template_id, 'hex') AS "couponTemplateId", discount_type AS "discountType", threshold_amount_yuan AS "thresholdAmountYuan", discount_amount_yuan AS "discountAmountYuan", discount_rate AS "discountRate", max_discount_amount_yuan AS "maxDiscountAmountYuan" FROM updated

WITH updated AS ( UPDATE user_coupon SET status = 'UNUSED', locked_order_no = NULL, locked_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE locked_order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'LOCKED' RETURNING id, coupon_template_id, user_id ) SELECT encode(id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", encode(coupon_template_id, 'hex') AS "couponTemplateId", user_id AS "userId" FROM updated

WITH updated AS ( UPDATE user_coupon SET status = 'USED', locked_order_no = NULL, locked_at = NULL, used_order_no = #{orderNo}, used_at = #{now}, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE locked_order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'LOCKED' RETURNING id, coupon_template_id, user_id ) SELECT encode(id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", encode(coupon_template_id, 'hex') AS "couponTemplateId", user_id AS "userId" FROM updated

WITH raw AS ( SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{ordersJson} AS jsonb)) AS raw( order_no text, user_id bigint, paid_at_epoch_ms bigint, order_amount_yuan numeric, discount_amount_yuan numeric ) ), updated AS ( UPDATE user_coupon c SET status = 'USED', locked_order_no = NULL, locked_at = NULL, used_order_no = raw.order_no, used_at = to_timestamp(raw.paid_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0), updated_at = NOW(), version = c.version + 1 FROM raw WHERE c.locked_order_no = raw.order_no AND c.status = 'LOCKED' RETURNING raw.order_no, c.user_id, raw.order_amount_yuan, raw.discount_amount_yuan, c.id, c.coupon_template_id ) SELECT order_no AS "orderNo", user_id AS "userId", order_amount_yuan AS "orderAmountYuan", discount_amount_yuan AS "discountAmountYuan", encode(id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", encode(coupon_template_id, 'hex') AS "couponTemplateId" FROM updated
mapper.update: UPDATE user_coupon SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'UNUSED' AND valid_end_at < NOW()
